description:
One extension's full listing from the catalog -- any extension, tracked by this account or
not: description, users, rating, reviews, version, languages, categories, permissions and
publisher. Pass the store and id of a search_catalog row as store and external_id.

English copy, refreshed weekly from the store; refreshed_at says when. This never fetches,
never answers "pending" and never starts tracking. users, rating and reviews are null when
the store shows no number, which is not zero. For an extension this account tracks,
get_metrics_history has its numbers over time. Shares search_catalog's
60 calls a minute per account.

Works without an account too.

external_id.description: Chrome's 32-letter id or the AMO slug, as a search_catalog row's id gives it.

name: get_listing
